stories.headline: Justice reform referendum campaign intensifies ahead of March 22-23 vote
stories.summary: Italy's constitutional referendum on judicial reform takes place this weekend, with PM Meloni campaigning for 'Yes' and opposition parties pushing 'No'. The reform would separate prosecutor and judge careers, create a new disciplinary body, and reform the CSM. Polls show a tight race.

articles.title: Referendum Giustizia, Meloni: "Sfida tra chi vuole cambiare e chi no"
Meloni agli italiani: "Al referendum votate sì per aprire una pagina nuova"
Italy's justice referendum tests PM Meloni and divided opposition
Giorgia Meloni is on a winning streak in Rome and Brussels. The referendum can end it.

stories.headline: Iranian attacks on Italian military bases prompt security review and troop repositioning
stories.summary: Iranian forces have attacked multiple bases housing Italian military personnel in Kuwait and Iraq. A drone strike destroyed an Italian MQ-9 Predator at Ali Al Salem base in Kuwait. Italy is withdrawing some troops and debating its role in the US-Israeli conflict with Iran.

articles.title: Drone contro base italiana in Kuwait: distrutto un velivolo
Crosetto: 'Cellule dormienti iraniane, centinaia nel mondo'
Iran, rischio terrorismo. Crosetto: 'Centinaia di cellule dormienti'

stories.headline: Lega founder Umberto Bossi dies at 84, triggering political tributes and reflection
stories.summary: Umberto Bossi, founder of the Lega Nord party, died at 84 in Varese. Political figures across the spectrum paid tribute, with his funeral scheduled for Pontida. His death highlighted tensions within Lega about the party's transformation under Salvini.

articles.title: Morto Umberto Bossi, fondatore della Lega. Mattarella: l'Italia perde un sincero democratico
Salvini: 'Tutti qui grazie all'idea di Bossi'. Domenica a Pontida i funerali

stories.headline: Justice undersecretary Delmastro faces scandal over business ties to organized crime family
stories.summary: Andrea Delmastro, undersecretary for justice and FdI member, was revealed to have business connections with the family of Mauro Caroccia, convicted for mafia-related crimes. Opposition parties demand his resignation while Meloni calls him 'careless' but keeps him in post.

articles.title: Delmastro in affari con un condannato per mafia: bufera su FdI
Caso Delmastro, l'imbarazzo di FdI: Arianna Meloni parla di 'gogna mediatica'

stories.headline: President Mattarella receives honorary doctorate in Salamanca, delivers speech on European values
stories.summary: President Sergio Mattarella traveled to Salamanca, Spain where he received an honorary doctorate and delivered a speech emphasizing Europe's role in defending multilateralism and rejecting absolute sovereignty. He met with Spanish King Felipe VI and called for Europe to say no to conflicts.

articles.title: Mattarella: 'Tocca alla Ue dire No ai conflitti e al sovranismo assoluto'
Mattarella a Salamanca: "L'Europa dica no all'ampliamento dei conflitti"

stories.headline: Government implements fuel excise cuts to counter energy price increases from Iran conflict
stories.summary: The Italian government approved a decree cutting fuel excise taxes for 20 days to help families and businesses cope with energy price rises linked to the Iran conflict. The measure reduces taxes by about 25 cents per liter, costing hundreds of millions of euros.

articles.title: Italy PM Meloni cuts excise duties to soften fuel prices as judicial reform vote looms
Il governo taglia le accise per 20 giorni contro il caro carburante
